provenance: Capability records grounded in READMEs, repo trees, SECURITY.md and docs listings fetched 2026-09-22 (see reference-systems.json). Anything not observed is marked UNKNOWN in notes, never asserted. reuse vocabulary per programme; our_status per programme truth vocabulary.

capabilities.name: Personal gateway (laptop or team deployment)
capabilities.description: One Gateway process runs the assistant personally or shared; configuration is the only difference. State, memory and credentials stay on owner hardware.
capabilities.security_notes: Local-first credential storage claimed; team mode shares the same process — assess multi-user isolation before trusting (UNKNOWN from fetched material).
capabilities.rationale: Gateway shape informs P21; no dependency adopted, first-party gateway planned.

capabilities.name: 20+ channel integrations
capabilities.description: Discord, iMessage, Slack, Teams, Telegram, WhatsApp and more via a channels tree plus web UI.
capabilities.security_notes: Each channel is a credential-bearing integration; per-channel token scope and revocation must be verified before use (UNKNOWN from fetched material).
capabilities.rationale: Channel breadth informs P27; integrations adopted only as scoped adapters later.

capabilities.name: Swappable model/provider plugins
capabilities.description: Claude, Codex and local models attach as plugins without changing the rest of the system.
capabilities.security_notes: Plugin boundary must prevent model output from reaching credentials; verify per integration (UNKNOWN from fetched material).
capabilities.rationale: Matches our P18 fabric direction; already partially built, no dependency taken.

capabilities.name: Device nodes (macOS/iOS/Android/Windows/Linux apps)
capabilities.description: Native apps extend the assistant onto devices.
capabilities.security_notes: Device enrollment, attestation and revocation model must be verified before trust (UNKNOWN from fetched material).
capabilities.rationale: Device reach belongs to P21 adapters when a concrete need arrives.

capabilities.name: Automation routines and VPS deployment
capabilities.description: Scheduled routines plus docs/automation and VPS hosting path.
capabilities.security_notes: Scheduled execution with broad grants needs the same misfire/approval discipline as P19; their exact policy is UNKNOWN from fetched material.
capabilities.rationale: P19 scheduler covers the mechanics; VPS hosting stays a deployment option, not architecture.

capabilities.name: Auth and credential semantics
capabilities.description: Documented auth/credential semantics for the gateway and its integrations.
capabilities.security_notes: Directly comparable to our vault + scoped-token principle; details UNKNOWN from fetched material (file listed, not read).
capabilities.rationale: Read before designing vault-adjacent work; no code taken.

capabilities.name: Typed JSON-first pipelines
capabilities.description: Pipelines pass typed objects/arrays, not text pipes; shell steps, native steps and macros compose; CLI, SDK and recipe modes.
capabilities.security_notes: Shell steps execute locally with the invoker's authority; output byte limits exist (LOBSTER_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES) but are opt-in.
capabilities.rationale: P19 runtime is proven; typed-pipeline ergonomics noted without adopting the engine.

capabilities.name: Approval and input gates with resume
capabilities.description: Explicit approval/input gates pause pipelines; the host presents the gate and resumes on decision.
capabilities.security_notes: Gate presentation channel must itself be trusted or approvals can be spoofed (UNKNOWN from fetched material).
capabilities.rationale: Equivalent proven in P19/1; no action needed.

capabilities.name: No new auth surface
capabilities.description: Lobster must not own OAuth/tokens; it borrows the host's authority model.
capabilities.security_notes: Aligns exactly with our skills-never-authorize rule; worth preserving as stated principle.
capabilities.rationale: Already our rule; cited as independent confirmation.

capabilities.name: Composable token-saving macros
capabilities.description: Named macros invocable in one step by OpenClaw or any agent.
capabilities.security_notes: Macro expansion must preserve approval gates; verify before trusting (UNKNOWN from fetched material).
capabilities.rationale: P19 routines cover configured reuse; macro ergonomics noted.

capabilities.name: Skill publish/version/rename/merge with changelogs and tags
capabilities.description: Publish SKILL.md-plus-files packages, version with latest tags, rename without breaking links, merge duplicates into canonical slugs.
capabilities.security_notes: Publishing pipeline integrity (who can publish/update what) must be verified; moderation hooks exist per README.
capabilities.rationale: Our promotion lifecycle covers trust; publishing UX and canonical-slug merging are the transferable ideas.

capabilities.name: Embedding-based skill search
capabilities.description: Search skills via embeddings instead of keywords.
capabilities.security_notes: Index poisoning (malicious skill text ranking high) needs moderation pairing; they document hooks, details UNKNOWN.
capabilities.rationale: Genuine gap: semantic discovery over the skill registry.

capabilities.name: Stars, comments, curation and moderation
capabilities.description: Social curation plus admin/mod approval workflows for skills.
capabilities.security_notes: Centralized moderation power needs transparency; compare with our independent-review + owner-approval gates.
capabilities.rationale: Our review gates are stronger (independent + owner); social signals noted for later.

capabilities.name: Native/bundle package catalog with trust metadata
capabilities.description: Code plugins, bundle plugins and whole-agent Claw packages with family/trust/capability metadata and exact artifact resolution.
capabilities.security_notes: Whole-agent packages executing code are high-risk; exact-artifact resolution plus trust metadata is the right shape.
capabilities.rationale: Genuine gap: versioned skill/plugin package format with trust metadata.

capabilities.name: Pinned local installs immune to force reinstall
capabilities.description: Frozen local copies that updates cannot overwrite.
capabilities.security_notes: Pinning is a supply-chain control; verify hash enforcement behind the label (UNKNOWN from fetched material).
capabilities.rationale: Our version pinning covers the semantics; hash-enforced pins noted.

capabilities.name: Channels, threads, DMs and bots
capabilities.description: Team chat primitives with bot/agent participation, scriptable CLI and TS SDK behind one API-first service.
capabilities.security_notes: Bot permissions per channel/role must be explicit; details UNKNOWN from fetched material.
capabilities.rationale: Core P27 shape reference; no dependency adopted.

capabilities.name: WebSocket live updates with durable event log
capabilities.description: Realtime delivery over WebSockets backed by a durable database event log; offline replay implied by architecture.
capabilities.security_notes: Reconnect/auth on sockets and backlog access control need verification (UNKNOWN from fetched material).
capabilities.rationale: Genuine gap: realtime transport for future comms.

capabilities.name: Single-binary self-hosting with SQLite default
capabilities.description: One Go binary, embedded web app and migrations; SQLite/uploads local by default, Postgres/R2 optional.
capabilities.security_notes: Self-hosting aligns with local-first; multi-node Postgres/R2 modes reintroduce shared-credential scope questions.
capabilities.rationale: Deployment shape noted for P27 planning; nothing adopted.

capabilities.name: Scheduled and event-driven issue/PR review
capabilities.description: Reviews open issues and PRs on schedule and exact GitHub events; one durable markdown report per item.
capabilities.security_notes: Scheduled automation with repo write nearby needs least-privilege tokens; their profiles model this, details UNKNOWN.
capabilities.rationale: Genuine gap: automated repo-health review feeding P16 truth.

capabilities.name: Marker-backed review comments edited in place
capabilities.description: One synced public review comment per issue/PR, edited in place rather than spammed.
capabilities.security_notes: Comment-edit scope must be limited to owned marker blocks to avoid clobbering maintainer text.
capabilities.rationale: Concrete technique worth adopting when steward automation is built.

capabilities.name: Guarded repair and automerge with readiness gates
capabilities.description: Narrow trusted findings become guarded repair/automerge work; readiness is explicitly not merge authority; closes only unchanged high-confidence policy-allowed proposals.
capabilities.security_notes: Matches our approval architecture; automerge scope must stay policy-gated.
capabilities.rationale: Readiness-vs-authority separation already ours; automerge mechanics noted.

capabilities.name: Maintainer chat commands (e.g. re-review)
capabilities.description: Comment-driven commands triggering fresh evidence-gathering review cycles.
capabilities.security_notes: Command authorization (who may trigger, on what) must be explicit to avoid drive-by automation.
capabilities.rationale: Useful operator interface for future steward work.

capabilities.name: VNC remote desktop with relay and clipboard
capabilities.description: Mac/Linux/Windows VNC connectors plus browser companion: negotiated video/audio, clipboard, optional file transfer, Tailscale or relay transport.
capabilities.security_notes: Remote input + clipboard + file transfer is high-risk: password auth, transport pinning and explicit enablement required; verify per deployment.
capabilities.rationale: Genuine gap: governed remote-desktop adapter (auth, scoped clipboard/transfer). No fleet semantics exist here despite the name.

capabilities.name: Saved computer endpoints with discovery
capabilities.description: Saved VNC connections, discovered direct endpoints, wake-on-lan, warm sessions.
capabilities.security_notes: Stored endpoint credentials must use the vault/reference pattern, never plaintext alongside config.
capabilities.rationale: Endpoint registry shape informs P21 device adapters.

capabilities.name: Remote/SSH/container runners with warm workspaces
capabilities.description: Run repo commands on remote machines, SSH hosts or local containers; warm reusable environments or one-shot cleanup runs.
capabilities.security_notes: Their trust model explicitly excludes adversarial tenants and hostile shared hosts; our runners must ADD isolation rather than copy this assumption.
capabilities.rationale: Runner mechanics inform P20; VM-B registry exists; real runners and isolation still missing.

capabilities.name: Working-tree diff sync with streaming output
capabilities.description: Sync uncommitted changes and nonignored files without pushing; stream logs; return exit codes; exclude build dirs.
capabilities.security_notes: Sync scope must exclude secrets/credentials explicitly; verify ignore rules before trusting (their docs describe exclusions).
capabilities.rationale: Genuine gap: workspace-sync contract for remote runners.

capabilities.name: Repository execution configuration treated as executable
capabilities.description: Repo config can select providers/binaries, mount hosts, forward env: reviewed like CI workflows, explicitly untrusted by default.
capabilities.security_notes: Adopt the stance directly: unknown repo configs are executable automation until reviewed.
capabilities.rationale: Policy stance worth mirroring for future runner configs.

capabilities.name: Shared GitHub read relay with cache
capabilities.description: Cloudflare Worker + D1 cache serving shared hits; token-free transports first, then healthiest pooled identity with sticky leases.
capabilities.security_notes: Pooled PATs/private keys live as Worker secrets; requires owner authorization, scoped tokens, budget visibility; never a ToS/rate-limit evasion tool.
capabilities.rationale: Genuine gap: authorized scoped relay-cache for repo API reads.

capabilities.name: Rate-budget-aware identity routing
capabilities.description: Per-identity rate buckets combined; Durable Object picks the healthiest budget with short sticky leases against stampedes.
capabilities.security_notes: Budget pooling must never become limit evasion; per-identity accounting with audit is the honest form.
capabilities.rationale: Routing pattern informs P30 relay design if ever built.

capabilities.name: Cross-cutting: no second scheduler/router/registry/policy
capabilities.description: Meta-finding across all eight: none of the systems justifies a duplicate Aetherius scheduler, model router, skill registry, policy engine, identity system, worker controller or messaging store.
capabilities.security_notes: Duplicates multiply audit surface and split authority; integration into canonical owners only.
capabilities.rationale: Records the explicit no-duplication decision with evidence.
